applications.basis: M1 acknowledges receipt and M2 explicitly says the application will not move forward. The submission record identifies the recorded implementation variant, but no exact artifact is retained; no rejection reason is stated.
M3 invites the candidate to interview for Support Engineer B, which establishes progression. No submission record identifies the resume.

M4 acknowledges receipt but expressly says the application has not been reviewed yet. The generic statement that not everyone can be interviewed is not a rejection. No submission record identifies the resume.
M5 says the employer cannot employ residents of the candidate's state. This is an eligibility restriction, not evidence of a resume weakness. No submission record identifies the resume.
M6 says the requisition was cancelled and no one will be hired. This is a closed requisition, not evidence of a resume weakness. No submission record identifies the resume.

M7 records non-progression, but the later M8 correction says F reopened and invites the candidate to interview. The latest supported disposition is progressed, while both chronological events are preserved. No submission record identifies the resume.
